intro: Vancouver has an unofficial election result; oil-driven inflation is back on the Bank of Canada's radar; and AI infrastructure financing is looking shakier. Your Sunday evening edition, researched October 18.

weather.title: Cloudy · 10°C now
weather.summary: Sunday 14°/8°, mostly cloudy. Monday 14°/6° with periods of rain (55% daytime chance). Tuesday turns sunny at 16°/6°; Wednesday 16°/7°, cloudier later.

stories.title: Pete Fry wins Vancouver mayoral race in unofficial results
stories.summary: The City reports Green candidate Pete Fry at 98,494 votes. The newly elected council spans COPE, Green, OneCity and ABC candidates. Official results and plebiscite outcomes are due October 21.

stories.title: Bank of Canada warns oil shock could lift inflation
stories.summary: Governor Tiff Macklem anticipates a sharply higher inflation forecast amid sustained energy costs. Markets reportedly expect no October 28 move, but pricing for next year is more hawkish. Keep an eye on the Monetary Policy Report.

stories.title: Linus Torvalds submits AI-assisted Linux kernel patch
stories.summary: An AI-assisted change tackles multicore cache contention. A reported 23× synthetic speedup is not a claim of real-world production gains; interesting signal for AI-assisted systems engineering.

stories.title: AI data-center buildout runs into financing and delivery pressure
stories.summary: The FT reports delays and viability questions across planned US data centers. This reinforces the need to watch infrastructure debt and capex sustainability, not just model benchmarks.

stories.title: China proposes controls on some AI technology exports
stories.summary: Draft rules cover sensitive AI technologies; public consultation runs through November 15. Open-source and publicly available technologies reportedly remain mostly unrestricted, making the final scope worth following.

stories.title: Georgia Viaduct maintenance disrupts traffic
stories.summary: The City warns of fall lane reductions and a three-month Main Street exit ramp closure. Worth considering for downtown driving.
